Interface SlotGate

public interface SlotGate
The value of the GATING server-tier behavior — what a slot accepts and releases. The library's single server seam resolves a SlotGate for any slot by Address and applies it: a denied placement/pickup is vetoed before the mutation commits.

The GatingContext

Each decision receives the context of who/what is acting, so a gate can choose its own policy on the non-modded bypass. A container lock (invisible to a non-modded client) bypasses when the acting player can't see slot-state (§0050); an equipment gate that only accepts an elytra enforces unconditionally. The library owns the acting-player capture and the capability query; the gate decides what to do with them.

This generalizes Inventory Max's hand-rolled container-lock enforcement: a lock is just a SlotGate that denies place/pickup when its shared state says "locked" and the acting player is capable.

    • maxStackSize

      default int maxStackSize(net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, int vanillaMax)
      The per-item stack cap for this slot, given vanilla's own cap. This absorbs the old InteractionPolicy.maxStackSize dimension into gating — "what a slot accepts" includes "how much". The default imposes no extra limit (returns vanillaMax); a gate that wants single-item slots returns Math.min(1, vanillaMax). The caller re-clamps to vanilla, so a gate can never raise the cap above what vanilla allows.
